title: Castelcicala to the Marchese di Circello, 1816-1819 (ASNa Esteri 2337; DECODE R9553, R9555-R9557, R9582-R9586)

documents.shelfmark: ASNa, Ministero degli affari esteri 2337_4-2337_37; DECODE R9553, R9555, R9556, R9557, R9582, R9583, R9584, R9585, R9586

plaintext.source: No decipherment on DECODE or in print; box 2317 record R9549 uses a different code.

transcription.source: Authenticated DECODE images, 3 of 13 pages transcribed
transcription.notes: Dotted numerical groups 14-2460; some groups carry a trailing 0.

system.summary: The Neapolitan Segreteria di Stato's general numerical code (groups 14-2460), no word division.

prior_solution.where: DECODE marks all nine non-decrypted; no edition found

conditions.human_role: Selected the target; the DECODE session cookie was already in the repository.

solution.what: Fetched metadata for DECODE R9542-R9590 through the API and the 28 images of the target and of box 2317/2337 siblings with the shared cookie.
Web search for a printed or published decipherment of the 1816-19 Castelcicala despatches.
Transcribed 331 groups from R9553 p.1, R9582 and R9585; identified the recipient (Circello) and the code name (Cifra della Segreteria di Stato).
Compared with the box 2317 record R9549 that DECODE suggests holds the plaintexts: its cipher uses a different code (frequent groups 441, 486, 563, 1144; range to ~1999).
Checked the decrypted box 2337 siblings: 1850s-60s telegrams and letters in other codes.
Frequency and repeat count: 208 distinct groups in 331 over a ~2,500-group code, repeated multi-group phrases; too little text for a ciphertext-only attack.

outcome.notes: Needs the Segreteria di Stato codebook of 1816-19 or deciphered copies in ASNa.
